findings.body: This lookup passes the exact lower date even though `ingest_batch.period` stores the first day of each month. Any window beginning after day 1 excludes that month's active budget batch while `monthCount` still counts the month. For example, a relative "last 3 months" window starting on July 4 queries budget periods from July 4, omits the July 1 batch, and falsely returns the no-budget answer even when every covered month has Budget. Normalize the lower bound to the month's first day and add a non-month-boundary range test.
findings.title: Not done: budget ranges include the starting month

findings.body: The backend emits `plantNames`, `budgetStates`, and `leftOut`, but the unchanged Ask UI does not consume them. Its informational branch at `frontend/src/features/assistant/ask-panel.tsx:238` renders only `definition`, so the no-budget `message` is blank; null Budget/% cells also lack the required accessible labels and no plant or left-out readout appears. The Tasks table assigns this presentation work to MP-ASK-UI-RESULTS.
findings.title: Later: MP-ASK-UI-RESULTS must render the new answer metadata

findings.body: The current `answerRowShape` path still recognizes only single-dimension `gl_code` and `leaf_key` answers (`backend/src/chat/chat.service.ts:1039`). Consequently, `gl_code × plant` and `leaf_key × plant` cannot receive per-row labels or drill contexts, and the required inert composite month shapes are not yet proven through `askRowKey`. The Tasks table assigns this work to MP-ASK-DRILL.
findings.title: Later: MP-ASK-DRILL must support composite row identities

findings.body: `monthsInWindow` is newly exported but has no production or test caller. The implemented coverage path deliberately uses a bounded metadata query plus `monthCount`, so this second unbounded month-expansion API adds dead surface and an alternative range algorithm that no Done-when item needs. Remove it rather than retaining an unused export.
findings.title: Simpler: unused month enumerator → remove it
